feature: Crypto agency marketing landing page — clear conversion funnel for services (token launches, smart contracts, audits, Web3 strategy), lead capture, social proof, and portfolio highlights.
screens: Hero with primary CTA and brief value prop
Case studies / portfolio strip with filters
Contact / Request a Proposal form (lead capture modal)
Footer with quick links, newsletter signup, legal
components: Top navigation: left logo (SVG) + right nav links + primary CTA button (Hire Us) — sticky with 4px subtle shadow on scroll

Hero: two-column grid — left: headline (H1), subhead, 2 CTAs (Primary: Request Proposal, Secondary: Explore Cases), trust bar (logos, 3 items); right: device mockup or animated token orb (SVG) inside accessible figure with alt
Service cards: 3–4 cards with icon (decorative aria-hidden), title, 1-line summary, CTA link; cards have 16px padding, 8px gap, 8px border-radius, focus ring
Case study carousel: horizontal scroll with snap, each slide has image, 2-line summary, KPI badges; keyboard and swipe enabled
Pricing: tier cards (Starter, Growth, Enterprise) with monthly/annual toggle (aria-pressed) and feature lists with check icons
Contact form modal: fields Name, Company, Email (type=email), Budget (select), Message (textarea), file upload optional; client-side validation and server response states
Newsletter signup: single-line email input + submit button with inline validation and success microcopy
Footer: sitemap, socials, legal links, small copyright
Microcopy elements: tooltips, helper text, success/error banners
interactions: Sticky header: becomes 56px compact at scroll >64px, animate height with transform + opacity (reduced-motion respect)
Hero CTA click: primary opens contact modal; secondary scrolls to Case Studies with smooth scroll (prefers-reduced-motion support)
Service card hover: elevation + scale 1.02 with 120ms ease; on keyboard focus show 2px outline color token
Case carousel: swipe + drag on touch, keyboard arrow navigation, pagination dots (aria-controls) and snap-to-slide behavior
Pricing toggle: instant UI update with aria-live region announcing selected billing period
Form submit: optimistic loader (spinner inside button), disable on submit, show inline field errors and top-level error summary with focus management
Newsletter: debounce input, validate, then show inline success message without page reload
Modal: trap focus, ESC closes, return focus to triggering element
states: Default, Hover, Focus, Active for buttons/links
Disabled states for form submit and CTAs when required fields invalid
Loading state for async content (skeleton cards for services and cases)
Success and Error banners for forms (informative copy, 4.5:1 contrast)
Empty state for Case Studies filter (illustration + action to reset filter)
Reduced-motion mode: all non-essential animations disabled
responsive: Mobile-first. Breakpoints: 0–599px (mobile single column), 600–959px (tablet: two columns stack), 960–1279px (desktop medium: two-column hero with smaller gaps), >=1280px (wide desktop: increased container max-width 1280px). Navigation collapses into accessible hamburger at <960px. Touch targets >=44×44px. Images lazy-loaded, CSS grid/flex with no fixed px overflow. Hero image scales fluidly (max-width 560px).
design_system: Primary tokens (proposed): --color-bg: #0F1724 (deep navy); --color-surface: #0B1220; --color-accent: #00D1B2 (teal); --color-accent-600: #00BFA0; --color-cta-text: #04202A; --color-text: #E6F0F6; --color-muted: #9AA8B3; --color-danger: #FF6B6B. Accessibility: text contrast >=4.5:1 for body, >=3:1 for muted. Typography: Inter (variable) for UI, GT Sectra or Merriweather for display if needed. Scale: H1:48/56, H2:32/40, H3:24/32, body:16/24. Spacing scale: 8/16/24/32/48/64. Radius: 8px default. Elevation: surface layers with subtle blur (backdrop-filter optional) and color-anchored shadows. Icons: outline system, SVG sprites, decorative marked aria-hidden. Motion: durations 120ms/200ms/320ms, easing: cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1). Dark-first palette; provide light-mode inversion if required. Tokenized CSS variables and Figma styles ready for handoff.
api_needs: GET /cases?featured=true&filter=... — paginated case list with images and KPIs
Analytics events: track CTA clicks, form submit success/failure, case view (send to GA4/Segment)
acceptance_criteria: Hero loads within 1s (image optimized, lazy load non-critical) and linkable via anchor
Primary CTA opens contact modal and focus is trapped; form validation prevents submit when required fields missing; successful submit returns 201 and shows success banner
Navigation accessible: keyboard tab order logical, hamburger labelled, ARIA on menus, focus visible
All images have alt text; decorative SVGs marked aria-hidden
Color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) for body text and AA Large for headings; testing checklist included
Responsive: layout does not horizontal-scroll at any breakpoint and touch targets >=44×44px
Case carousel keyboard and swipe operable and provides visible focus and aria-live updates for slide changes
Design tokens exported to Figma: colors, typography, spacing, elevation, and component variants for buttons, cards, forms
